pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are designing a rate limiter — a system that controls how many requests a single user is allowed to make to an API within a given time window (for example, no more than 100 requests per minute per user). The system needs to work correctly even when your API is served by dozens of servers running in parallel, and it needs to handle tens of thousands of users concurrently. Walk through how you would design this system. Cover the data structures and storage layer you would use, how you ensure the limit is enforced correctly across multiple servers, how you handle edge cases like users who send requests at exactly the boundary of a time window, and what tradeoffs you made in your design.
